description.value:
You turn your gestalt wildshaping energy inward, forcing long, curved spurs of hardened bone to erupt from your skin at joints, knuckles, elbows, shoulders, and knees. The spurs are razor-sharp and cause significant damage to anything that presses against them.

While this spell is active, you gain the following benefits:
- When you successfully Grapple a creature, you deal 3d6 piercing damage to that creature in addition to the Grapple's effects.
- At the start of each of your turns while you have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed}, that creature takes 2d6 piercing damage.
- Any creature that hits you with an unarmed strike or natural attack takes 1d6 piercing damage (no save).

This spell has the morph trait and does not suppress your normal polymorph or wildshape capabilities (the spurs modify, not replace, your form).

Heightened (7th) The initial Grapple damage increases to 4d6, the per-turn grab damage increases to 3d6, and creatures you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} also take a -1 circumstance penalty to saves against your spells.
